manifest.title_fil: BMI at angkop na chart ayon sa edad
objectives_fil: Piliin ang adult BMI o age-appropriate chart, ipakita ang kalkulasyon at yunit, at ipa-review ang kahulugan kung kailangan.
objectives_en: Given fictional height/weight/age, calculate or plot using the correct approved tool and state a safe follow-up.

sections.takeaway_fil: May tatlong kathang-isip na kaso na magkaiba ang edad at sukat.
sections.takeaway_en: Three fictional cases have different ages and measurements.

sections.takeaway_fil: Piliin ang adult BMI o age-appropriate chart, ipakita ang kalkulasyon at yunit, at ipa-review ang kahulugan kung kailangan.
sections.takeaway_en: Calculate or plot using the correct approved tool and state a safe follow-up.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang pinakamainam na gagawin ng BHW sa sitwasyong ito?
check.prompt_en: What should the BHW do in this situation?

options.fil: Gumamit ng adult BMI cut-off sa lahat ng bata.
options.en: Apply adult BMI cut-offs to every child.

options.fil: Piliin ang adult BMI o age-appropriate chart, ipakita ang kalkulasyon at yunit, at ipa-review ang kahulugan kung kailangan.

options.fil: Ipagpaliban nang walang plano o pag-follow-up.
options.en: Delay without a plan or follow-up.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi ito ligtas o hindi nakumpirma. 2: Ito ang angkop na unang hakbang. 3: Walang malinaw na susunod na hakbang.
check.feedback_en: 1: This is unsafe or unconfirmed. 2: This is the appropriate first step. 3: No next step is arranged.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa kathang-isip na kasong ito, ginamit ni Mira ang kasalukuyang lokal na gabay bago sumagot.
sections.takeaway_en: In this fictional case, Mira checks the current local guide before responding.

sections.takeaway_fil: Iwasan ang ganitong kilos: Gumamit ng adult BMI cut-off sa lahat ng bata.
sections.takeaway_en: Avoid this action: Apply adult BMI cut-offs to every child.

sections.takeaway_fil: Piliin ang kilos na may nakikitang resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Choose the action with an observable result.

check.prompt_fil: Aling kilos ang nagpapakita ng maayos na pagtupad?
check.prompt_en: Which action shows the task was done well?

options.fil: Ginamit ang kasalukuyang lokal na gabay at naipakita ang mahalagang hakbang: Piliin ang adult BMI o age-appropriate chart, ipakita ang kalkulasyon at yunit, at ipa-review ang kahulugan kung kailangan.
options.en: Selects adult BMI versus child/adolescent chart correctly, shows units and refers for interpretation where required.

options.en: Say the task is complete without recording an outcome.

options.en: Apply adult BMI cut-offs to every child.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Ito ang nakikitang patunay ng gawain. 2: Walang naitalang resulta. 3: Hindi ito ang angkop na kilos.
check.feedback_en: 1: This is observable evidence of the task. 2: There is no recorded result. 3: This is not the appropriate action.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa susunod na pinangangasiwaang pagsasanay, gamitin ang kathang-isip na kasong ito.
sections.takeaway_en: At the next supervised practice, use this fictional case.
